summary: Pre-deployment verification for Rodomisto Rappresentanze after adding GET /health top-level. Backend: 15/15 new focused pytest cases PASSED (/health, auth for umberto & andrea, /api/auth/me role, giri invariance, andrea sees only own clients, recurrences 2 aziende + order/undo, /api/payment-modes = 7, POST /events order with agente_60 -> due_at = created_at+60d and payment_mode_label, anticipato & contrassegno -> due_at None, sospeso manual + collection clears same-company, overdue deferred order auto-generates suspension exposed in /api/clients). Full backend suite 91/91 green. Frontend (mobile 390x844): giro search on Dashboard works end-to-end — filters dynamically by ragione_sociale or comune, shows 'RISULTATI' section with count, shows 'Nessun cliente trovato' when no match, X button clears and restores full list with working quick-actions. IMPORTANT PROBE NOTE: GET /health returns 200 {'status':'ok'} when hit directly on the backend pod (localhost:8001), but through the public Kubernetes ingress non-/api paths are routed to the Expo frontend so https://<host>/health returns the frontend HTML (200). This is fine for a Kubernetes liveness/readiness probe (targets pod:8001 directly). If the deployment probe is instead configured against the public URL, /health at the ingress will not reach the backend. No product regressions detected. Deprecated RN-web style warnings unchanged from prior iterations.

action_items: Confirm the Kubernetes livenessProbe/readinessProbe targets the backend pod directly on port 8001 (not the public https://<host>/health, which the ingress routes to the frontend). If the probe is at the ingress, either (a) route /health to the backend service via ingress rules, or (b) expose /api/health additionally so the existing /api ingress rule handles it.
(Optional, low priority) Migrate RN Web deprecated style props: shadow* -> boxShadow, props.pointerEvents -> style.pointerEvents.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: GET /health is correctly declared on the top-level FastAPI `app` before the `/api` APIRouter is included; returns {'status':'ok'} with 200. No other logic changed.

Ingress note: the review request asks GET /health (no /api prefix) to respond 200. This works at the pod level but not through the current public ingress because non-/api paths are forwarded to the frontend. Deployment probe wiring needs to be aligned.

frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx: giro search uses Unicode-aware normalization (NFD + diacritic strip + toLowerCase) matching on both ragione_sociale and citta; empty-state footer + X-clear button are correctly wired to giro-search-clear testID.

rca_of_issue: N/A — no product bug. The initial single test failure (test_overdue_deferred_order_auto_suspension) was a test-isolation issue: the previous test in the same run created a collection for company X at 'now', which correctly settled the past-due auto-suspension inserted afterwards for the same company. Fixed by using a different company (companies[1]) for the auto-suspension test. This actually confirms the collection-clears-suspension logic in server.py::_active_suspensions_for is working as designed.
